bluf: Wednesday brings the highest combined threat posture since this brief was established. Karmelo Anthony was found GUILTY of murder Tuesday evening and immediately sentenced to 35 years. Crowd outside the Collin County Courthouse broke into shoving, chanting 'Free Karmelo,' and traded insults between opposing groups. Austin civil unrest risk is now at its PEAK — protests expected throughout Wednesday on Capitol/Congress Ave corridor and UT campus. Simultaneously, U.S. forces launched retaliatory strikes against Iran after Iran downed a U.S. Army Apache helicopter near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran retaliated against the U.S. Fifth Fleet (Bahrain), a U.S. airbase in Jordan, and Kuwait — active armed conflict is underway. FIFA World Cup opens TOMORROW (June 11) — Iranian diaspora tensions at peak given military conflict; cyber posture is HIGH. Heat index 98–102°F today. All senior staff brief before morning shift. Emergency escalation protocols on standby.

incidents.title: Karmelo Anthony — GUILTY + 35-Year Sentence
incidents.location: Collin County Courthouse / Austin-wide protest watch
incidents.detail: Karmelo Anthony, 19, was found GUILTY of murder Tuesday evening after jury deliberated less than three hours. Immediately sentenced to 35 years in prison. The jury rejected his self-defense claim — Anthony never testified and defense rested without any witness substantiating self-defense. Crowd outside the courthouse broke into shoving, chanting 'Free Karmelo,' and emotional confrontations between opposing groups. Deputies monitored. Wednesday is historically the highest demonstration day post-verdict. Civil rights groups had pre-positioned protest activity. Guilty verdict with 35-year sentence + all-white jury controversy will drive sustained Austin street action. PRIORITY WATCH ZONES: Texas State Capitol grounds, Congress Ave, UT West Mall, 6th Street. Exterior staff must not engage demonstrators. Contact APD non-emergency (512-974-5000) if any crowd exceeds 50 persons within 2 blocks of 98 San Jacinto Blvd. Maintain HIGH posture all day.
incidents.source: CNN / ABC News / Dallas Morning News / Fox News

U.S. CENTCOM launched 'self-defense strikes' against Iranian targets in southern Iran. Iran's IRGC then struck: U.S. Fifth Fleet Headquarters in Bahrain; U.S. airbase in Jordan; Kuwait. Active armed conflict between U.S. and Iran — prior ceasefire has collapsed. AUSTIN RELEVANCE: Iranian diaspora in Austin's tech sector deeply alarmed — combination of WC team staged in Tijuana, military strikes, and WC opening tomorrow (June 11). Brief all staff on avoiding geopolitical commentary with guests. Log any suspicious inquiries about U.S. military operations. DHS/FBI emergency protocols now active at all WC host cities.

civil_unrest.detail: Post-verdict Wednesday is maximum-risk day for Austin demonstrations in this cycle. The 35-year sentence with an all-white jury has social media on fire — 'Free Karmelo' trending nationally. Civil rights groups had pre-positioned for either verdict; guilty with long sentence is more likely to drive sustained street action. Expect rallies at Capitol grounds, marching on Congress Ave, possible convergence toward 6th Street in the evening. No confirmed permitted march in Austin as of 5 AM — expect spontaneous gathering. Monitor X, Telegram, Instagram for Austin-specific organizing keywords. KEY PROTOCOL: If crowd approaches within 2 blocks of 98 San Jacinto Blvd, lock down secondary entrances, post additional staff at lobby doors, notify APD. Do NOT engage demonstrators. Protect guests' movement safely.
